state.persona: Matt, 30s, New Yorker, on day 2 of a 6-day Lisbon trip with his partner Sam. Standing on a Lisbon street on his phone (390x844), battery at 12%, wants to decide what to do in the next few minutes without reading much. Loves classic rock and rock bars. Knows nothing about the app internals.
state.job_to_be_done: Find live rock music to go to TONIGHT in Lisbon.
state.workflow_state: On his trip page, day 2, 20:15. He scrolls to a panel titled for tonight. Ticket feeds (Ticketmaster/SeatGeek) are not connected in this deployment.
state.visible_text: Live music tonight in Lisbon / [row] 🎸 Rock cover bands — Because you listen to rock, classic rock. — Look for: Live-music bar · Pub with a stage · Roadhouse / IN LISBON ON YOUR DATES / [small grey badge] Event feeds not connected / [button] 🎸 Rock cover band bar in Lisbon ↗
state.what_taps_do: The only button opens a Google Maps search for 'rock cover band bar Lisbon'. It does not list tonight's gigs.
state.not_shown: No events, no venues, no times, no 'no listings tonight' sentence. Elsewhere on the same page an idea card titled 'Live music tonight in Lisbon' also opens a generic Maps search for 'live music bar Lisbon Portugal'.

honest.instructions: Probability that Matt correctly understands that the app has NO information about which bands are playing tonight.

believes_tonight.instructions: Probability that Matt believes the Maps button leads to places with live rock music tonight.

useful.instructions: How useful is this panel for getting Matt to a live rock gig tonight?
criteria: A hint of where to look
A specific gig tonight he can go to
